_note: Constructed cases. Every case here was written for this demo; none is a real customer record. S01 is modelled on a public incident report (AI Incident Database #1028: an agent asked to compare prices bought eggs for $31.43). The agent step logs, store records and the answer key (expected.liable, expected.firstDeviation, expected.quickClose) are hand-written and fixed before any AI run. fixtureFacts are hand-written stand-ins used only when the AI provider is 'fixture'.
